boc_custom.ponder.tag.first_ship.descrip: Learn how to make a boat with Valkyrien Sails
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_1: This is an example ship for Valkyrien Sails
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_2: We start with Buoy Blocks and Ballast Blocks
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_3: Ballast Blocks are used to offset the weight of the mast and sails
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_4: We need plenty of Buoys to support the wood, mast, sails, and ballast blocks
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_5: Add a Helm and Helm Wheel - This will not provide forward motion like Eureka Helms
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_6: Add a nice tall mast to support your sails
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_7: Add your sail blocks, and optionally add ropes to connect them to the ship
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_8: Sails use wind to push you forward
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_9: And use the helm to change the angle of motion
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_10: Imagine there's a rutter in the back of the boat that you are turning
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_11: Right click the ropes or sails to disable and hide them
boc_custom.ponder.first_ship.text_12: There's no way to reverse in the mod yet, so don't get stuck
